# 逐字弹入

每个字母从下方带弹性交错弹入，俏皮而有节奏感。悬停预览窗即可重播。

来源：https://github.com/xiyu519/MotionVault/blob/0a201da92e4b4fa7436b1c79c7f249bc66329644/src/components/effects/text/LetterStaggerPreview.tsx

版本：0a201da92e4b4fa7436b1c79c7f249bc66329644

许可：MIT（保留上游 LICENSE）

触发：hover

## 原始实现提示词

Create a React component with Framer Motion that animates each letter of a
headline with a springy stagger entrance: letters slide up 24px from opacity
0 using a spring (stiffness 300, damping 18) with a 0.04s stagger. Wrap each
letter in an inline-block span so transforms work. Replay the animation when
the user hovers the container. Tailwind for styling.
